unicode-normalizer.name: Unicode Normalizer
unicode-normalizer.description: Normalize text with NFC, NFD, NFKC or NFKD and compare Unicode code points and byte counts.

meta.title: Unicode Normalizer
meta.description: Normalize text with NFC, NFD, NFKC or NFKD and compare Unicode code points and byte counts.
meta.keywords: Unicode normalization, NFC, NFD, NFKC, NFKD, combining accents, fullwidth, code points

unicodeNormalizer.hint: Up to {limit} UTF-16 code units in the input and {outputLimit} in the output. Whitespace is preserved.
unicodeNormalizer.NFC: NFC: canonical decomposition followed by composition. Example: e + combining acute accent → é.
unicodeNormalizer.NFD: NFD: canonical decomposition. Example: é → e + combining acute accent.
unicodeNormalizer.NFKC: NFKC: compatibility decomposition followed by composition. Example: Ａ ﬃ ① → A ffi 1.
unicodeNormalizer.NFKD: NFKD: compatibility decomposition. Also separates composed accents.
unicodeNormalizer.compatibility: NFKC and NFKD can remove meaningful distinctions such as width, ligatures and superscripts. Choose a form that suits your data.
unicodeNormalizer.unchanged: The text is already in the selected form.
unicodeNormalizer.countHint: Code points are not visible character counts: combining marks and emoji sequences can contain several code points.
unicodeNormalizer.previewHint: Code point preview: first {limit} code points on each side. Copy and download include the complete normalized text.
unicodeNormalizer.emptyResult: Enter text and normalize it to see the result.
unicodeNormalizer.rules: Runs locally using the browser’s Unicode version. Normalization does not change case, remove invisible characters or detect lookalikes. It is not a text sanitizer.
unicodeNormalizer.inputLimit: Use at most {limit} UTF-16 code units in the input.
unicodeNormalizer.outputLimit: The normalized output exceeds {outputLimit} UTF-16 code units. Use a smaller input.
unicodeNormalizer.invalidUnicode: Unpaired UTF-16 surrogate at code unit position {position} (starting at 1). Replace the invalid character.
unicodeNormalizer.invalidForm: Choose NFC, NFD, NFKC or NFKD.
